data.heading: Fourteen years of villas in North Goa
data.description:
Coastline Villas started in Assagao in 2012, building four villas on a single lane. Today we sell, design and manage villas across Bardez.

We list only homes whose titles we have checked, and we tell you what a villa will really cost to run.

data.heading: Questions we are often asked
data.description: Can’t find your answer? Call us — we are happy to help.

items.question: Can NRIs buy villas in Goa?
items.answer: Yes. NRIs and OCI card holders can buy residential property in India; we guide you through payments from an NRE/NRO account.

items.question: What is a sanad?
items.answer: A conversion sanad allows construction on land. We check that every villa and plot we list has the right conversion and approvals.

items.question: Can my villa be rented out when I am not there?
items.answer: Yes. Our management team handles bookings, housekeeping and maintenance for a share of the rental income.

items.question: Are prices negotiable?
items.answer: Some are. We tell you honestly how much room there is, based on recent sales nearby.

data.content:
This policy explains how Coastline Villas collects, uses and protects the personal information you share through this website.

Information we collect

When you send an enquiry or request a site visit we collect your name, phone number, email address and the details you provide, such as the property you are interested in.

How we use it

We use your details only to respond to your enquiry, arrange visits and share relevant properties. We do not sell your information. We may share it with the builder or owner of a property you ask about, only to arrange a visit.

Your choices

You can ask us to correct or delete your information at any time by writing to the email address on our contact page.

By using this website you agree to these terms.

Listings

Property details, prices and availability are provided by owners and builders and may change without notice. Please verify all details before making a decision.

Fees

Where a brokerage fee applies, it is agreed in writing before any site visit.

Liability

Coastline Villas is not liable for decisions made only on the basis of information on this website.

The images on this website are illustrations and may not represent the actual property.

Prices exclude stamp duty, registration charges, GST and other statutory charges unless stated. RERA registration numbers are shown where applicable; buyers should verify them on the RERA website.
